regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, graphical abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current activator-free Pd-catalyzed regioselective gamma-arylation class. The graphical abstract is an aggregate reaction-class summary, not an additional experiment.

regions.region: page 1 two-column Introduction and Scheme 1 citations
regions.finding: Classified the cited functional-propargylamine deamination, activated-ammonium gamma-alkylation, and prior alpha-substitution work as literature context; the present generic class is separated from concrete experiments on later pages.

unresolved: The graphical abstract and Introduction contain generic structures/R groups rather than experiment-specific charges or yields.
The publisher's Supporting Information badge does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 1A-D and caption
regions.finding: Visually separated three cited prior-work classes from the present generic activator-free gamma-arylation. The Scheme 1B -40 °C condition and catalyst/ligand loadings are retained only in its literature record.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-14, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization rows independently with catalyst, ligand, solvent, 120/100 °C, 3 h, air, 1a/K2CO3/solvent charges, boronic-acid 2 versus 2.5 equiv footnote, water 10:1 footnote, and isolated/trace/n.d. outcomes. Entry 13 is merged with the matching standard 3aa procedure.

regions.region: page 2 lower Results and Discussion
regions.finding: Mapped optimization prose and scope overview to Table 1 and Scheme 2/3 records without prose duplicates. SI-only unsuccessful optimization details were not inferred.

unresolved: Optimization workups/masses/detection limits are absent except for the merged standard entry 13.
Other base/loading/water/time screens are referred to unassociated SI Table S1 and were not fabricated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 complete propargylamine scope and caption
regions.finding: Recorded all seventeen displayed products 3ba-3ra independently with exact row yields/times and shared caption charges. Their later individual masses and common procedure are merged into the same records.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 boronic-acid scope and caption
regions.finding: Recorded eleven successful products 3ab-3al and displayed failure 3am independently. Structurally duplicate products introduced from different partners remain distinct experiments. The 3ah 4 h row conflicts with the caption's 1.5-3 h range and both statements are retained.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left narrative unsuccessful boronic acids
regions.finding: Recorded four main-text unsuccessful tests ((E)-styryl, 4-formylphenyl, n-pentyl, pyridine-4-boronic acid) without assigning unprinted standard conditions because details are deferred to unassociated SI Table S2.

regions.region: page 3 middle-right Scheme 4 scale-up and two product transformations
regions.finding: Recorded the distinct 2 mmol 3aa scale-up and two independent transformations 3aa to indene 4 and benzophenone 5. Later procedures and product sections are merged into these arrows.

regions.region: page 3 lower mechanistic prose and conclusion beginning
regions.finding: Linked the proposed oxidative-addition/hydroxide/transmetalation/reductive-elimination cycle to Scheme 5; proposed intermediates are not experiments.

unresolved: 3ah time conflict: row 4 h versus Scheme 3 caption 1.5-3 h.
Four narrative failures lack main-text conditions because SI Table S2 is unassociated.
Scale-up source units print TBP 0.2 mol and boronic acid 5 mol despite a 2.0 mmol substrate charge.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 5
regions.finding: Classified A-C as proposed Pd-cycle intermediates and recorded the ordered oxidative-addition/rearrangement, hydroxide formation, transmetalation, and reductive-elimination steps without treating intermediates as preparations.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left general information and product-3 procedure
regions.finding: Applied air, ordered reagent/solvent charge, 5 mL Schlenk tube, 120 °C oil-bath reflux, TLC endpoint, cooling/extraction/filter/concentration, and petroleum-ether flash chromatography to standard scope rows. The printed TBP 4.0 mg/0.02 mol/10 mol% discrepancy is retained.

regions.region: page 4 top-right scale-up continuation
regions.finding: Structured every printed scale-up amount, DCE/water volume, preheated 120 °C/3 h hold, TLC endpoint, workup, purification, 184.5 mg and 34% outcome. Printed mol-versus-mmol conflicts remain unresolved.

regions.region: page 4 right-column procedures for products 4 and 5
regions.finding: Structured ordered operations, quantities, temperatures/times, quench/extraction/drying/purification, and yields. For product 4, TfOH 1.5 equiv versus 0.15 mmol and later yield/mass conflicts are explicitly retained.

regions.region: page 4 right-column individual products 3aa-3fa
regions.finding: Merged exact product names, isolated masses/yields, appearances, and silica/petroleum-ether purification into their matching Table 1 entry 13 or Scheme 2 rows; spectra remain characterization, not new experiments.

unresolved: Common-procedure TBP is printed as 0.02 mol despite 4.0 mg and 10 mol%.
Scale-up TBP/boronic-acid mol units conflict with scale and equivalents.
Product 4 procedure contains TfOH and substrate-description conflicts.

regions.region: page 5 left-column product sections 3ga-3oa
regions.finding: Merged individual names, masses, yields, yellow-oil appearances, and petroleum-ether silica purification with Scheme 2 products 3ga-3oa. NMR/HRMS text is characterization only.

regions.region: page 5 right-column product sections 3pa-3ra and 3ab-3ag
regions.finding: Merged individual names, masses, yields and appearances with the matching Scheme 2/3 records. Alias products such as 3ae=3ca remain distinct reaction records because partner/conditions/outcomes differ.

unresolved: Spectral assignments were inspected as characterization context but not expanded into reaction records or machine structure verification.
Individual sections do not restate starting-material charges; the common procedure supplies them and retains its TBP unit conflict.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left product sections 3ah-3al
regions.finding: Merged exact names, isolated masses/yields, and yellow-oil appearances into the corresponding Scheme 3 records. Cross-page characterization continuation for 3ag adds no new experiment.

regions.region: page 6 middle-left product sections for indene 4 and benzophenone 5
regions.finding: Merged product appearances/masses with Scheme 4 transformations. Retained the product-4 conflict: Scheme/general procedure 41% and 22.0 mg versus individual section 22.0% and 32.7 mg; product 5 is consistently 25.1 mg/69%.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left Associated Content/SI statement
regions.finding: Publisher availability text only. Source mapping marks SI association unestablished; no SI procedure, spectrum, Table S1-S3 value, or structure was inferred.

regions.region: page 6 right-column author/funding and references beginning
regions.finding: Administrative and bibliographic material only; cited external experiments were not imported as present-paper records.

unresolved: Product 4 source conflict remains unresolved: 41%/22.0 mg versus 22.0%/32.7 mg.
Online SI availability does not establish a workspace SI association.
References are prior literature and were not re-extracted as current experiments.
